subject: [DB] Database migrations for the first release (469 tables, 32 schemas)
description: One forward-only migration per schema, applied forward by SqlMigrationRunner, which records each file and its checksum (handoff/service-docs/backend/MIGRATIONS.md). The tables, columns, keys, indexes and row-level security are already written in backend/ as derived DDL; each migration takes its schema's first-release tables from there. Order matters: each migration only references tables created by the ones before it.

subject: [BE] AI engine: Block A (gateway, baseline layer, concierge, Help me choose, translations, planner agent)
description: Built by the two AI engineers from 5 October (decided 30 September). Every AI answer works on day one from a baseline and learns from the tenant's own data; a trained model replaces the baseline only when it beats it and an admin approves (AI-D16). The AI endpoints and screens are built by the developers under their own tickets.

subject: [AI] The baseline-then-learn layer: estimator interface, maturity stages, venue profile, starting patterns
description: The baseline-then-learn layer: estimator interface, maturity stages, venue profile, starting patterns. One interface per AI question with three answers behind it (starting pattern, statistical on the tenant's data, trained model); the stage and 'based on' label on every answer; the venue profile entered at onboarding; starting patterns per venue type with the UAE calendar and weather; no other tenant's data. About 15 engineer-days; the rest of the layer continues in Block B.

subject: [AI] Guest concierge: retrieval over the venue's knowledge, answers with sources
description: Guest concierge: retrieval over the venue's knowledge, answers with sources. Knowledge ingest and reindex, semantic search, the concierge conversation with the venue's content as its only source, and the answer cache keyed by scope. About 8 engineer-days.

subject: [AI] Evaluation harness and the promotion alert
description: Evaluation harness and the promotion alert. Offline evaluation of every AI answer type against a fixture, the backtest runner the learned producers will use, and the promotion-ready alert to the admin (AI-D16). About 5 engineer-days.

subject: [AI] AI gateway, governance decision point and usage metering
description: AI gateway, governance decision point and usage metering. One gateway every AI call goes through: provider (managed Azure by default; BYOK where TICVAI enables it), policy check (evaluateAiGovernance), usage and spend (getAiUsage), and the decision record for every answer. About 10 engineer-days.

subject: [AI] Help me choose: suggested question sets from the product catalogue
description: Help me choose: suggested question sets from the product catalogue. proposeGuidedChoice suggests filter questions from product attributes (age and height rules, levels, certifications); the operator edits and publishes, nothing is published automatically. About 4 engineer-days.

subject: [AI] The planner agent on top of the rules planner
description: The planner agent on top of the rules planner. The agent refines the rules plan by chat, with the plan operations as its tools; when AI is off or fails it falls back to the rules plan, never to an error. About 8 engineer-days.

subject: [AI] Day-one suggestions for the Block A screens: queue balancing, prep plan, upsell
description: Day-one suggestions for the Block A screens: queue balancing, prep plan, upsell. requestSuggestion answers from the baseline on day one for the kinds Block A screens call (BO-005, GST-031, WEB-044), with the upsell baseline from the Promotions relationship map. About 8 engineer-days.

subject: [AI] Content translation English and Arabic for the CMS
description: Content translation English and Arabic for the CMS. proposeTranslations for CMS content, reviewed by the operator before publishing. About 3 engineer-days.

subject: [BE] Offline-first: journal, signed bundles, leases, sync, POS to kitchen
description: What the POS, the Kitchen Display and the scanner need to keep trading with the network down (SD-047, SD-028, SD-046, SD-052).

subject: [BE] Platform kernel: tenant routing, scope, idempotency, outbox, payments, audit, observability
description: The machinery every service stands on and no screen asks for. Found missing by the system-design review of 29 September (SD-063, SD-047). Sprint 1 target: one web purchase and one offline POS cash sale end to end by 23 October.

subject: [DevOps] PostgreSQL (tenant and control databases) and a forward-only migration runner that applies the MIG epic in order
description: PostgreSQL (tenant and control databases) and a forward-only migration runner that applies the MIG epic in order. In **ticvai-backend**: `SqlMigrationRunner` (in the starter) applies `db/tenant` and `db/control` - the package's derived DDL - in file order and records each file with its checksum in `platform.schema_version`. The databases run on Azure in the UAE region, connection strings from the cell's Key Vault (audit R057). Done when: both databases exist in dev, the runner applies every MIG file to an empty database, and a second run applies nothing.

subject: [DevOps] Logging and monitoring basics
